evidence.quote: 用币安的 AI Pro 跑的海力士韩美价差收敛策略，现已平仓落袋！
早上起来看到韩美价差收敛到 49%，账面显示有大概 $87 的利润。

我打开合约页面，确实看不到持仓，它又提示资金在子账户。打开子账户的合约页面，依旧没有持仓，这时候我开始慌了，想着钱难道丢了？
这时我已经开始后悔，没好好把流程完整的走一遍就直接上实盘。最后还是去子账户的交易记录里翻，才确认仓位其实已经平掉了。
虽然最终本金没有问题也赚了点钱，但没能及时平仓，而且很波折。甚至于有些提心吊胆！
1/ 和 AI Pro 的对话在主账户，但策略跑的资金在子账户，也就是资金和仓位情况无法直接看到的。

items.author: indigox
items.new_information: 称5月Agent流量已超人类，主张先降负载再定价

evidence.quote: 用什么来替代互联网的旧商业模式？这是未来五年最有意思的问题，Matthew Prince 在 Cloudflare Connect 2026 开幕 Keynote 给出了他们的答案：“先降负载，再给剩下的部分定价” 👀
在今年五月，Cloudflare 检测到的 Agent 流量已超过人类流量，按现在的趋势外推，五年后 Agent 流量会是人类流量的 1000 倍，人类在网络上会变成“舍入误差”。原因不是人类不再上网，我们的流量大体持平，而是越来越多的内容由 Agent 来替人去消费。
第一是“只抓取变化的内容”。Google 式的抓取不管页面变没变都会重抓，AI 公司照搬了这种做法，非常低效。Cloudflare 与 OpenAI 合作，主动告诉对方哪些页面更新了，从而降低整个生态的总负载，连 Google 也认同这个方向。
第二是“代理使用你的内容时，你要能收到钱”。他把这两点概括成一句话：先降负载，再给剩下的部分定价。最后他强调 Cloudflare 做不到独自完成这件事，需要伙伴一起定义这个可持续的未来。

items.author: oragnes
items.new_information: 8把CA私钥可被秒级恢复，浏览器已封锁但服务器与容器生态仍信任
items.urgency_reason: 仍信任缺陷证书的系统面临窃取密码与API密钥的中间人攻击，行动窗口在补丁部署前，今天就应更新浏览器、系统并核查服务器依赖

evidence.quote: 印度数字证书机构 eMudhra 的8把CA私钥被发现存在致命缺陷，本该拥有384位安全强度的私钥，实际竟然只是4、56、66、115、155、156、230、237这8个数字。
安全研究员 Scott Helme 用普通笔记本不到1秒就恢复了全部私钥，而且这些证书从2025年4月就已经存在。
攻击者掌握这些私钥，就有能力伪造任意网站的HTTPS证书，在仍然信任这些证书的设备上，配合网络流量劫持实施中间人攻击，窃取密码、API密钥，甚至篡改通信内容。
但Python、Node.js、Go、服务器、Docker容器及部分老旧设备，可能仍然信任这些证书，整个软件生态的清理远比浏览器复杂。

Indian CA eMudhra issued 8 intermediate certificates in April 2025 with extremely weak private keys (tiny numbers like 4 or 56 on P-384 curves). Anyone could recover them in seconds from public data and forge trusted HTTPS certs for any site. A researcher reported it Oct 17 with proof. Chrome, Firefox, Apple and others blocked them quickly. No known
malicious use, but update browsers, OS and apps—many systems still trust the old certs.
8 certificate authority private keys have been compromised.

Millions of IoT devices, Docker containers, forgotten Linux machines, unmaintained CLI tools, etc. are all going to be relentlessly hacked via safely signed malware for the next several years or maybe indefinitely.

evidence.quote: It is true that tokenized deposits will only flow between whitelisted wallets that are already customers of the relevant bank. However they will be very useful as the cash leg of atomic swaps for tokenized assets (for instance Treasuries and equities to facilitate repos and stock loans). To say that tokenized deposits are purely performative is

Due to run risk, a tokenized deposit can never be a bearer instrument. The bank must know who every token holder is at all times to manage the FDIC (or foreign equivalent) insurance limit. Otherwise a single customer could put $1m into 4 wallets and quadruple their insurance, thus Sybil Attacking the FDIC.

Also due to run risk, tokenized deposits cannot be allowed to trade freely in the secondary market. Stablecoins like USDT and USDC have micro-depegs all the time due to liquidity, but nobody cares because they are fully reserved. A tokenized deposit having even the slightest depeg could cause a run on the entire bank.
I'm guessing the reason Yuval is upset about my post is because JPMD is soon coming to Canton. That deployment actually makes sense. They should definitely do it.

evidence.quote: The usual playbook for cutting AI risk has three parts, and each does a different job:
1️⃣ Equal-weight index funds: you’re less reliant on a few giant tech stocks, but you’re still in the stock market.
2️⃣ Short-term T-bills: you earn ~4% interest while your cash stays ready to use.
3️⃣ Long-term bonds: riskier than they look. If rising rates are what’s hurting AI stocks, these get hurt too.
Since 2021, BTC fell on 85 of Nasdaq’s 107 worst days (−2% or more), including 38 of 46 during the 2022 rate-hike selloff. But in the April 2025 tariff shock, it rose on 4 of 6.

If AI sells off on rates or liquidity, BTC has tended to fall with it, so it’s the same risk in a different wrapper. If AI sells off on payoff disappointment while liquidity holds, BTC has room to decouple.
So BTC can be a good bet on its own, but don’t count on it to cushion an AI selloff.

evidence.quote: I didn't predict and do not predict defense running ahead of offense automatically. I predict cybersecurity will be endgame defense-favoring but the transition will be hard. In particular, "good guys find vulns in already-released software before the bad guys do" is not a defense-favoring game. Making the game defense-favoring requires deeper shifts in
methodology including formal verification, aggressive TCB minimization, etc, and we've only barely started making those transitions.

此次PHP严重漏洞由OpenAI与谷歌的AI模型协助发现，而非6个月前的Anthropic Mythos扫描，MIRI主席Nate Soares称这是对"防守领先进攻"理论的沉重打击。
Vitalik Buterin回应称，他从未预测防守会自动领先。抢在攻击者之前发现已发布软件的漏洞并非防守占优的局面，扭转格局需要形式化验证、精简可信计算基等深层变革，而这些才刚起步。
这也是他支持放缓AI发展的重要原因，他呼吁将超过1%的GDP投入网络、生物与物理世界的安全加固。

吴说获悉，以太坊联合创始人 Vitalik Buterin 回应近期 AI 发现 PHP 严重安全漏洞引发的攻防争论时表示，他从未预测网络防御会自动领先于攻击，而是认为网络安全长期最终可能形成有利于防守方的格局，但转型过程将十分艰难。他指出，仅依靠安全研究人员抢在黑客之前发现现有软件漏洞，并不能从根本上建立防御优势。真正改变攻防格局需要在技术方法上进行深层改革，包括形式化验证、最大限度缩小可信计算基础（TCB）等，而这些转型目前才刚刚开始。这也是他继续支持考虑放缓或暂停 AI 发展的重要原因之一，并主张将超过 GDP 1% 的资源投入网络安全、生物安全及现实世界的安全防护。https://t.co/Qe9rTThAEq
